prompt: Create a polished bright Windows desktop utility application icon for TrayKit, a compact toolbox that restores clipboard images across remote desktops. One simple cyan and azure rounded toolbox silhouette combined with a small white clipboard photo tile and a yellow lightning accent. Bold large shapes, joyful bright colors, clean vector-like edges, no text, no letters, no watermark, centered composition with generous clear padding, plain white background, legible at 16 by 16 pixels. Square app icon.
